ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Film ticks
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that film a stretch of a scenario one picture every N game ticks, instead of by the clock. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See FilmTicks/README.md at the repository root.
It exists because Pickle's own @film takes ten pictures a second by the clock, and an effect that lives one tick in fifteen is caught by chance. The same feature, as a scenario tag, is proposed to Pickle itself; when it lands this mod's steps can go.
